import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
L=Path.cwd()
for name in ['threads','tutte-final','rightgroups']:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(L/'sources'/f'{name}.pdf'),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
 w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),f'sources/{name}.txt'],input=r.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
 print(name,len(r.stdout),len(r.stdout.split('\f')))
print(Path('sources/threads.txt').read_text())
